title: Get Your Marriage On! with Dan Purcell
author: Dan Purcell | Sex & Intimacy Coach | Christian Husband
description: It's a challenge to build a long term marriage that is passionate, full of love, affection, and sexually fulfilling for both. It can be especially challenging for Christians in a world filled with mixed messages about sex, intimacy, and marriage that go contrary to traditional values. Your host is Dan Purcell, your marriage and intimacy coach with a masters degree in counseling. He specializes in helping married couples take their sex life to the next level. You'll gain new ideas, perspectives, and practical tools to help you "get your marriage on"! This podcast discusses fun and spicy topics you've always wondered about, from a Christian-friendly perspective. For more information, visit https://getyourmarriageon.com.
